expectations.text: report.md relays a gate/judgment question to the owner about certification go-ahead (or delta-worthiness) rather than deciding it
expectations.evidence: "Your call: was the fix round behind v2 delta-worthy..." — explicitly states the records cannot settle it and does not lean; also notes certification "needs its own explicit go-ahead; answering 'patch-grade' alone won't start it".

expectations.evidence: Delta ~0.6-1.2M tokens; certification pair ~4.0-4.6M; single-pass ~2.9M — all three branches costed.

expectations.evidence: "The router exits 3 — a judgment call — at the delta-worthiness fork" plus the v2 state readout (3 verified, 0 reopened, 0 new serious).
